author: claude-fable-5-1
visual_review_findings: Compared the original (tall house with a peaked roof, a door and three wavy steam lines above) with the rejected drawing (a squat 44-wide barn with a notch door and three tight curls) at 48px in both themes. Redrew on VRECT_L: a taller house with a 32-wide peaked roof, walls to the floor, an arched door, and three tall S-shaped steam wisps 10 apart above the peak. Native review: reads as a sauna cabin with steam; wisps clear each other by 8.9.
construction_reference: Lucide house (peaked roof, arched door) construction
